name: blender mug with solidify subsurf and loop cuts
goal: Block a coffee mug from a cylinder using Edit mode, Solidify, Subdivision Surface, and Ctrl+R loop cuts (from Blender Guru beginner series).

inputs.name: cylinder
inputs.description: Cylinder to turn into mug body

outputs.name: mug_body
outputs.description: Thickened, smoothed mug shell with supporting loop cuts

constraints: Start relatively low-res before heavy Subdivision Surface
Apply Solidify before extruding a handle so thickness does not double on the handle
Ctrl+R loop cuts control where Subsurf stays sharp

steps.action: Add/position cylinder as mug; Tab Edit mode; shape walls (scale loops) toward a mug silhouette.
Add Solidify modifier for wall thickness; adjust thickness non-destructively.
Add Subdivision Surface; raise Viewport levels carefully; note how unchecked edges become overly round.
Ctrl+R add loop cuts near rim/base to hold shape under Subsurf; slide and confirm.
Use reference image (Add Image Reference); clear bad rotation, set 90° with Ctrl-snap; scale to match mug.
Before handle extrudes: Apply Solidify so inner/outer walls are real mesh; then extrude handle geometry from an appropriate face.

verification: Loop cuts visible in Edit mode
